description: This file contains unit tests for the ClaimDao class related to claim expense functionalities in the OrangeHRM system. It tests saving, retrieving, listing, and deleting claim expenses using PHPUnit framework.

classes.name: ClaimDaoExpenseTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class for testing ClaimDao's claim expense related methods.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ClaimDao object and loads test fixture data before each test.

methods.name: testSaveClaimExpense
methods.description: Tests saving a new claim expense and verifies its assigned ID.

methods.name: testGetClaimExpenseById
methods.description: Tests retrieving a claim expense by its ID.

methods.name: testGetClaimExpenseList
methods.description: Tests retrieving a list of claim expenses filtered by request ID.

methods.name: testDeleteClaimExpense
methods.description: Tests deleting claim expenses associated with a specific request ID.
